lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
viewer-init: 14,118 B beyond the first copy, focus-trap 13,656 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B, vue-demi 13 B.
viewer-main: 8 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
1,446 B in 4 pieces of 3 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (152 packages, 1,281 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
